Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> blackday wrote:
> So base on the rulebook officially only Camarilla, Sabbat, Laibon, and Independent are sects? Would like to get an official decision by james or Pascal regarding that.
>
That's correct (based on the rules). As it's vaguely relevant to the whole category of pretending to be a trait you don't have, Independent is the "default" sect for things that don't specify a sect. This can be vaguely important when 'pseudo-vampire' allies play an effect as a vampire - if it has an effect based on the playing minion's sect, the ally is Independent.

[LSJ 20060126]
>
> LSJ wrote:
> vampires without a sect designation (like
> allies posing as vampires) are independent.
>
It's always been understood that having "Independent" (or, originally, "non-Camarilla") as a sect is a little odd, thematically speaking - Ravnos aren't in a secret club with Daughters - but it makes things flow more easily if everything has a sect.

For the record, though, I don't make official decisions.
